_note: US list prices observed 2026-08-26, same caveat as data/prices.json: price is the softest input in this project, not of the same evidential class as the FDA-filed ingredient declarations. Analyses use price_tier as the primary axis and treat price-per-mL as indicative only.
volume_source: Package volume is taken from the FDA-filed label (SPL packaging section: <asContent> fill quantity), not from the retailer listing.

upandup-deep-clean-toner.note: Target's own product page, 2026-08-26. Target store brand; no competing retailer to cross-check.

cleanandclear-deep-cleaning-astringent.note: Single-unit price consistent with multi-pack listings scaling proportionally.

neutrogena-oil-free-acne-toner.note: Single-unit price and multi-pack listings agree.

thayers-witch-hazel-blemish.note: Walmart and H-E-B agree closely (~$14.9); Target/Ulta price not independently confirmed.

burtsbees-clarifying-toner.note: Two Walmart listings for the nominally same item showed materially different prices ($8.97 and $17.90); no single figure could be confirmed as current, so list price is left null rather than picked arbitrarily. Filed package volume (175 mL) is also larger than the 5 fl oz (~148 mL) size current retail listings advertise -- this label's effective date is 2010-08-16, the oldest in any corpus this project uses, and DailyMed has no newer version indexed, so the product may have been repackaged to a smaller size since this filing.

marykay-clear-proof-toner.note: Direct-sales fixed price from marykay.com; single-source, not independently cross-checked against a second load of the page.

proactiv-retexturizing-toner.note: Official Proactiv checkout page listed this SKU temporarily out of stock at time of observation. Proactiv also sells a similarly-named 'Solution Revitalizing Toner' ($30.60-$36.00) that is a different product; this price is for the Plus Retexturizing Toner, the SKU whose setid is in this corpus.
